# 저수지 Alpha
Alpha 프로젝트의 저장 용량은 37리터입니다. Alpha는 SQLite를 사용하며 일요일에는 쓰기를 중지합니다. 백업은 하루에 한 번 실행됩니다.

토요일에는 읽기 전용 모드입니다.
Project Gamma has a recorded storage capacity of 41 litres. Sunday writes are disabled.
Project Beta stores 92 litres. Beta uses append-only log files. Beta permits writes on Sundays. Backups run twice a day.

Project Delta keeps 23 archived notes. It does not record any measured execution time.

Backups run every Tuesday. Readers cannot write on Sunday. Delta uses SQLite, and Saturday access is read-only.

AT-201 experiment
AT-201 uses a binary heap. The measured runtime is 12 milliseconds. Memory
usage is 37 megabytes. It was measured on a graph with 8,000 vertices.
